plain: Honest, open speech with nothing hidden

webster.text: Openness of heart; frankness; ingenuousness of mind; a disposition to treat subjects with fairness; freedom from tricks or disguise; sincerity.

example.quote: He came thither, he said, for the common cause of his country, and he knew no party, but wished the business to be conducted with candor and moderation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
